summary: Implementation plan for transforming the 3D world into a high-fidelity Solarpunk sanctuary with realistic PBR materials, dynamic animations (rotating wind turbines, swaying flora, animated river ripples, animated flying eco-drones), and authentic Solarpunk structures (Geodesic Hydroponic Dome, Kinetic Solar-Tree, Algae Bioreactor Lab, and Autonomous Eco-Drone Delivery Depot).
